paper.title_en: Bridging the Population Synthesis of Supermassive Binary Black Holes and the Gravitational Wave Background
paper.abstract_en: Pulsar Timing Arrays (PTAs) constrain population properties of supermassive binary black holes (SMBHBs) through the observation of the gravitational wave background (GWB). Unlike other approaches that interpolate population-synthesis libraries or only consider the mean of the strain spectrum, here we capture its full strain probability density directly from semi-analytic population models. We apply our new method to the semi-analytic SMBHB population model, independently reproducing the parameter estimation for this model performed by the NANOGrav Collaboration with their 15-yr data. We also show the extent to which discrete SMBHB contributions to the GWB resolve degeneracies in the population parameter space. Finally, using the source-count intensity as the intermediate product in our calculation, we map PTA observations, as a proof of principle, to the SMBHB model based on the galaxy merger prescriptions from numerical hydrodynamical simulations "Illustris". We find the effect of delay times $τ$ between kiloparsec and subparsec SMBHB separations following galaxy mergers, finding $h_{\rm c}$ spanning $(1$-$6)\times10^{-16}$ and $N_{\rm c}$ spanning $(0.3$-$7.1)\times10^{-3}$ for $τ$ up to 8 Gyr.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文直接面向脉冲星计时阵列（PTA）探测引力波背景的核心问题，提出从半解析种群模型直接捕捉完整应变概率密度的方法，避免了以往插值种群合成库或仅使用应变谱均值的局限；并以NANOGrav 15年数据独立复现参数估计，进而将PTA观测映射到基于Illustris数值流体动力学模拟的SMBHB模型，讨论了延迟时间τ的影响。方法新颖、结果具体，对PTA与超大质量双黑洞种群合成交叉领域具有较高阅读价值。
decision.title_zh: 连接超大质量双黑洞种群合成与引力波背景
decision.abstract_zh: 脉冲星计时阵列（PTAs）通过观测引力波背景（GWB）来约束超大质量双黑洞（SMBHBs）的种群性质。与插值种群合成库或仅考虑应变谱均值的其他方法不同，这里我们直接从半解析种群模型中捕捉其完整的应变概率密度。我们将新方法应用于半解析SMBHB种群模型，独立复现了NANOGrav合作组利用其15年数据对该模型进行的参数估计。我们还展示了SMBHB对GWB的离散贡献在多大程度上解决了种群参数空间中的简并。最后，以源计数强度作为我们计算的中间产物，作为原理验证，我们将PTA观测映射到基于数值流体动力学模拟“Illustris”的星系并合规定的SMBHB模型。我们发现了星系并合后千秒差距与亚秒差距SMBHB分离之间延迟时间τ的影响，发现对于τ直至8 Gyr，h_c spanning (1-6)×10^{-16}，N_c spanning (0.3-7.1)×10^{-3}。
